title: Prompts and configuration as code: versions, review and rollback

videos.script: Every number this course measured was measured with one prompt, one model and one set of settings. Change a sentence and the numbers may move. {{title}} So the prompt, the help centre pages and the model's settings are files under review. Each version is a hash of the file. {{versions}} The classifier routes ten of twelve tickets. A reviewer approves that version, with a name, a date and a reason. {{approve}} Then somebody adds a friendly sentence, asking the model to greet clients warmly. The check sees a version nobody approved. {{edit}} Nine right instead of ten. The model wrote a poem for one ticket. {{poem}} Because every call logs the version it used, the poem traces straight to the unapproved prompt. {{trace}} And the fix is to put back the last approved version, copied, not retyped. {{rollback}}
